structured.answer: Didn't really decide. I'm leaning toward an S&P 500 tracker at a big name, like מיטב's "גמל עוקב מדד S&P500" (0.53% fee, 13.89% over 3 years), but with 182 tracks and nearly identical fees I'd probably close the page and first find out which company my pension is with.

Every row looks the same (fees 0.4–0.6%), so I got bored and would have closed the page
